description: This Perl script manages configuration settings by parsing configuration files, applying logical operations, and outputting configuration states. It includes functions for loading, combining, diffing, and printing configurations, and processes command-line arguments to determine its behavior.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file, parsing lines with specific prefixes.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Performs logical AND operation on two configuration hashes.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line based on its value.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses configuration expressions from command-line arguments.
